lines: Episode 36 combines (a) host's reconstruction of a multi-month timeline linking the Macron investigation to events surrounding the Charlie Kirk assassination, much of which is host narration referencing prior-episode material, with (b) four distinct artifact-anchored evidentiary segments presented in this episode. A Tucker Carlson speech clip from the July 18 Turning Point event is also played. The episode does not present new primary artifacts supporting the bulk of the host's broader timeline claims about the Satys hanger, the Egyptian plane schedule, the foreign-dignitary transfer, the MK Ultra / Stanford line of investigation, or the phone calls with Andrew Kolvet and the unnamed CIA-contractor spouse; these are preserved as host assertions and excluded from the Claim Register per the admission test.
